questions.enonce_markdown:
Define the following terms:

i) Stimulus.

ii) Tropism.

iii) Reflex action.

iv) Effector. *(4, 4, 4, 3 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Stimulus:** any **change in the external or internal environment** (light, heat, pressure, chemicals, sound...) that is **detected by a receptor and causes a response** in an organism.

(ii) **Tropism:** a **growth movement of a part of a plant in response to a stimulus coming from one direction**; the direction of growth is determined by the direction of the stimulus. It is **positive** if towards the stimulus (e.g. shoots towards light: phototropism; roots towards gravity: geotropism) and **negative** if away from it.

(iii) **Reflex action:** a **rapid, automatic, involuntary response to a stimulus**, which does not need conscious thought (it is controlled by the spinal cord or brain stem). It follows the path **receptor, sensory neurone, relay neurone, motor neurone, effector** (the reflex arc), e.g. withdrawing the hand from a hot object, the knee jerk, blinking.

(iv) **Effector:** an **organ (a muscle or a gland) that carries out the response** to a stimulus after receiving impulses from a motor neurone; a muscle contracts and a gland secretes.
